status_at_design: exploratory reanalysis of existing Run002; no new training
user_hypothesis: The inclinations of cumulative A and B become equal; a zero slope of cumulative B/A tracks loss convergence and indicates that no additional information is stored because new gradient contributions are destroyed.
comparison: Within the same seed1234 Pythia14M AdamW trajectory, compare raw gradients and bias-corrected preconditioned Adam directions.
primary_exclusion: Final update712 has311 sequences instead of1024; preserve it in numerical data and full-pass sensitivity.
slope_coordinate: accepted optimizer updates; norm units per update, not rendered line angles
primary_derivatives: exact backward differences of recorded A, B and B/A; A0=B0=0; initial ratio derivative undefined
smoothing: trailing31-update means for norm differences and trailing31-point least-squares slopes for ratio and training loss; complete windows only
ratio_minimum_check: Use a centered61-update window around each stream's observed minimum within1-711; descriptive and selected after seeing the source figure.
loss: Recorded supervised-token-mean training loss on changing batches; initial/final full fixed validation only.

decision_scope.equal_absolute_slopes: Compare mean backward differences and least-squares slopes of A and B within the declared intervals.
decision_scope.ratio_plateau: Compare the ratio slope and the marginal slope ratio DeltaB/DeltaA against historical B/A; no fitted plateau threshold or significance test.
decision_scope.convergence: Describe late training-loss trends and smoothing sensitivity; cannot establish asymptotic convergence from a finite pass with only two fixed-validation evaluations.
decision_scope.information_storage: Not directly measured; distinguish geometric cancellation from loss change, parameter motion, and information stored by the model.

uncertainty: One seed, one correlated trajectory; window/smoothing sensitivity is not a confidence interval.
execution: Local CPU reduction and plotting only; source artifacts read-only.
